title: Spielberg's live IMAX interview for Disclosure Day

plain: A writer and producer named Bryce Zabel says that in 2026 he and a podcast host, Jesse Michels, watched a live interview with the film director Steven Spielberg at an IMAX theater, a cinema with an extra-large screen. The interview was tied to something called Disclosure Day, and Zabel brings up what Spielberg said there the night before as a hint about Spielberg's views on the subject of non-human intelligence.
